hook.text: A product owner writes: 'Given I'm logged in, when I click buy, then the order is placed.' Everyone understands.

buildup.text: BDD uses structured language—Given, When, Then—to describe expected behavior in plain English.

discovery.text: These scenarios serve triple duty: specification, automated test, and living documentation at once.

twist.text: BDD isn't about tools like Cucumber. It's about conversations that produce shared understanding.

climax.text: Teams using BDD have 40% fewer requirement misunderstandings because everyone speaks the same language.

punchline.text: Given shared language, When teams collaborate, Then bugs decrease.

quiz.question: What is the core purpose of BDD?
options: Creating shared understanding through structured scenarios
